dedup_note: Three rolling-window exports overlap heavily by date range (6579 rows across all three files are duplicates of a signal already seen in an earlier export). scripts/analyze_signals.py dedupes on (date, match, strategy, signal minute) before combining files. All numbers below are the deduped, combined-3-file numbers (n=8329 unique signals, 8311 decided).
breakeven_odds_formula: mindestquote = 1 / win_rate  (decimal odds needed so that, at this win rate, wins on average cover losses; anything below this quote runs at a loss even if the win rate holds)

MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5.note: Confirmed across three overlapping-but-deduped exports (n=3673 unique signals): win rate holds well through minute 65 (mostly 71-79%), then drops at 66-70 (60.2%) before a partial late bounce at 71-73 (66.7%). Tightening the upper cutoff trades volume for precision.

MoneyBag + 3 Goals -> Over 3.5.note: Minute 60 solid (72-75%), 61-63 still decent (69-76% depending on SoT), then decays through 64-71. <=63 remains the conservative cutoff; shots-on-target (9+ vs <=8) matters more than the minute alone in the 61-71 range - see tool_calibration.o35Matrix.

Over 2.5 Odd Filter.note: Now confirmed across two exports (09-27 and 09-30, n=747). Performance and time-decay pattern remain statistically indistinguishable from the base 'MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5' strategy, so the same dakika<=67 cutoff applies.

Over 0.5 Value.note: Signals fire almost exclusively at minute 61-62 despite the rule allowing up to 79'; minute 61 (72.9%, n=280) slightly outperforms 62 (67.9%, n=56). Still too little data past minute 62 to judge whether the wide 61-79 window is actually a risk - most of it appears unused in practice. Now has a dedicated model in tool_calibration.o05Buckets.

MoneyBag 0-0 -> Goal.note: Same pattern as 'Over 0.5 Value': signals cluster at minute 61-62. No signals observed yet in the 63-71 range to evaluate.

Over 1.5.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5.note: Strong at minute 60-64 (75.2%, n=109), thinner and weaker at 65-69 (63.2%, n=19), noisy small-sample bounce at >=70 (70.6%, n=17). See tool_calibration.o15Buckets for the merged model across all three 'Over 1.5' template variants.

Over 1.5 cloude.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 15 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 cloude.note: Same shape as 'Over 1.5': 76.8% at minute 60-64 (n=95), dropping to 66.7%/63.2% for 65-69/>=70 (n=24/19). Consistent with time decay.

Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.current_rule: dakika <= 75 | dakika >= 60 | paraCuvali = 1 | rx >= 300 | son5iki >= 60 | toplamGol = 1 | toplamSutTotal >= 10 | ustAdayi = 1
Over 1.5 claude 1.änderung.note: Best-performing of the three Over 1.5 variants (75.0% vs 73.1-73.2%), and unlike the other two it still holds up at 65-69' (76.0%, n=25). Worth watching as the strongest of the three, not yet enough to retire the others.

HT over 0.5.current_rule: dakika <= 20 | dakika >= 10 | maviBomba = 1 | rx <= 178 | s5 >= 3 | toplamGol <= 1 | toplamSut >= 3 | vanPersie = 1
HT over 0.5.recommended_rule: dakika <= 20 | dakika >= 10 | maviBomba = 1 | rx <= 178 | s5 >= 3 | toplamGol <= 1 | toplamSut >= 3 | vanPersie = 1
HT over 0.5.note: No new 'HT over 0.5' signals appeared in either the 09-27 or 09-30 export - still the same 40 signals from 09-20. The s5>=3 tightened rule (hypothesis from n=18 subset, see prior report) has not been re-tested against fresh data yet since the strategy hasn't fired again. Still unresolved - needs a fresh export where this strategy actually triggers again.

breakeven_odds_by_signal_minute.note: Mindestquote per signal-minute bucket, overall across strategies, three exports combined and deduped (n=8329).

breakeven_odds_by_strategy_and_signal_mi.note: Mindestquote per strategy x signal-minute bucket (n>=15), three exports combined and deduped. avg_over_odds is the observed average Over-odds for that combination. margin = avg_over_odds - breakeven_odds.

tool_calibration.note: Source of truth for tools/moneybag-analyst.html's DEFAULT_CALIB. Recomputed 2026-09-30 from all three exports combined and deduped (n=3673 for O2.5, n=2913 for O3.5, n=423 for O1.5 merged across its three template variants, n=343 for O0.5). Replaces the previous 2026-09-27 calibration.
tool_calibration.o15_o05_note: Merged across all three 'Over 1.5' bot-template variants (💰 Over 1.5 / cloude / claude 1.änderung) since they're the same underlying strategy under different rule-tweak names - splitting them would have made each bucket too thin to trust. The '68-71' bucket for O1.5 (37.1% wr, n=35) is a real danger zone, not noise: it sits between two much stronger buckets on both sides and matches the same late-signal decay seen in O2.5/O3.5. The '>=72' bucket (92.0%, n=25) is a small sample and should be treated with caution despite the high win rate - re-check once more data accumulates there. O0.5 signals fire almost exclusively at minute 61-62, same as MoneyBag 0-0 -> Goal and Over 0.5 Value in the strategies section above (same underlying signal family).

radar_x_score.note: No strong monotonic relationship with win rate (71.7-74.7% across all buckets from <200 to >=450 in the deduped combined dataset). Not currently a reliable standalone filter for the main strategies.

market_drop_pct.note: Mostly flat (72-73%) up to 20% drop, then a dip at 20-30% (66.7%, n=201), then back up at >=30% (72.7%, n=271). No clean monotonic pattern - likely too noisy on these sample sizes to act on yet.
